reply.text:
Congratulations, that's a big six weeks. When it's safe to run again after birth isn't something I can call, and it depends on how you delivered and how your recovery is going. Your doctor or a pelvic floor physio is the right person to clear you, and many people get that check around the six-week visit, so ask them directly about running.

Once you have the green light, I'm glad to build a gradual return around it, starting with walking and easy intervals and lifting alongside. Just tell me when you're cleared, or if you'd like a lighter strength plan in the meantime.
